integrity: All ranks and the Vámos 65-base enumeration arise from the described combinatorial and toric-divisor derivations; code is a finite exact check, not an infinite theorem prover.
scientific_limitations: Class groups and canonical Cartier property are determined for torus-fixed charts and globally. This does not classify the complete singular scheme, nongeneric local analytic germs, or all positive-dimensional orbit strata. Independent verification has not been performed.
title: A canonical Cartier phase transition in sparse-paving matroid toric varieties
